Name: Fancy Crops and Forage Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Retextured crops, forage and seeds icons for more fancier and fresher ingame look.
[/color]
Currently retextured most crops and forage (except flowers and some other objects). Here's retextures for Stardew Valley Expanded crops and forage too!

[b][u][color=#ff7700]For mobile players - download the android version in optional files.[/color][/u][/b]

[b]Highly configurable! You can combine this mod with mods like   [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]Better Crops and Foraging[/url][/b] 

[u][color=#ff7700]Configuration:[/color][/u]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Enable Veggies: "true, false",[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Enable Growing Crops: "true, false",[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Enable Fruits: "true, false",[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Enable Forage: ""true, false",[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Enable Misc and Special: "true, false",[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Enable Seedpackets: "true, false",[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Enable SVE Crops and Forage: "true, false",[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Seedpacket style": "colored, one tone",[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]CoffeeBeanType - big, small;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]MelonColor - yellow, green;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]ParsnipColor - turnip, parsnip.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]AncientFruitSeed - sprout, packet[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]
[font=Georgia][color=#ff7700]Credits: [/color]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Many icons taken from  [url=http:///henrysoftware.itch.io/pixel-food]Free Pixel Food tileset[/url]﻿  by Henry Software﻿ [/font]
[*][font=Georgia]The Tea Sapling texture is from [url=http://www.deviantart.com/orteil/art/A-whole-lot-of-RPG-items-379986564] free RPG items[/url]﻿ tilesheet﻿ by  Orteil[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]Many references and inspiration gained from Pinterest and Google[/font]
[/list][/font][u][font=Georgia][color=#fff2cc][center][/center][/color][/font][/u][/size]
